description: One payment for a two-party delegation record: you record the delegation now (signed, kind 30014, bound to your paying wallet), and the delegate's accept, the delivery seal and your receipt close are prepaid. Each later step is redeemed with its party's one-time token and costs nothing more. Steps not redeemed by the expiry (7 days) are refunded on the rail you paid with. Verify the whole chain at /v1/delegations/{id} with craigmbrown.com's DID document. (x402: $0.16 USDC per call)
name: bundle.delegation-chain
